item.title: Police warning on ‘potent batch’ of crack cocaine
item.description: Police have warned that a “contaminated or unusually potent batch” of crack cocaine in the Lincoln area has led to five suspected overdoses. Lincolnshire Police said it had received reports of five suspected overdoses on Thursday morning linked to crack cocaine use.
